scope: independent native-pixel verification of five women's casualwear visual profiles

reference.role: adult-subject facial and general appearance continuity only

schema_compatibility_normalization.reason: The v6 generator accepts the open-dimension names style and color, while the frozen Phase A cores used wardrobe, styling_details, or color_palette.

arms.concept: pre-dawn tidal observatory instrument calibration in sea mist
arms.coordinator_observation: A full center-front button placket, two distinct point-collar tips, one small fastening at each tip, and attachment of both tips to the shirt body are jointly visible.
arms.supplemental_failure: The meter display and staff contain readable calibration numerals despite a non-legible-markings constraint.

arms.concept: brutalist seed-bank accession audit under a clerestory beam
arms.coordinator_observation: The viewer-left bounded shoulder window is visible, but long hair fully hides the viewer-right window and bridge. Therefore paired cutouts, bilateral neckline continuity, bilateral sleeve attachment, and both finished edges cannot be verified in the same image.
arms.supplemental_failure: The accession packet also overlaps the front waistband.

arms.concept: rainy restored art-deco ferry terminal parcel handoff
arms.coordinator_observation: Two traceable front panels cross diagonally with visible overlap depth, form a wrap V-neckline, and remain closed by a visible side tie rather than a printed or faux diagonal.
arms.supplemental_failure: The forearm and parcel overlap part of the blouse front, violating the separate unobscured-outfit scene constraint without hiding the five wrap gates.

arms.concept: glasshouse kinetic-sculpture maintenance under colored caustics
arms.coordinator_observation: One tailored garment remains continuous from bodice through waist and crotch, then divides at a visible inseam into two full-length legs with separate hems; it is not a dress or matching separates.

arms.concept: underground book-conservation lab after a sprinkler alarm
arms.coordinator_observation: A shared waistband and rise lead into a visible crotch and inseam, two independently readable wide legs, and two separate mid-calf hems, excluding a skirt panel or floor-length palazzo substitute.
